_comment: Mission profiles - weights per dimension, used by the UI weight presets. Owner: Julia (task J5). This is Eduard's placeholder draft from Section 7.6 so the dropdown has something to show; Julia replaces the purposes and tunes the weights. Dimensions: T terrain, H thermal, M material, W water/ice, B biology, C construction, A atmosphere/dust, I illumination.

profiles.name: Balanced (default)
profiles.purpose: Every physical dimension counts equally - the neutral view.

profiles.name: Lunar south-pole operations
profiles.purpose: Rehearse surface operations under grazing light on rough polar terrain.

profiles.name: Base construction and site prep
profiles.purpose: Find ground you could actually build a permanent base on: flat, firm, excavatable.

profiles.name: Ice prospecting (ISRU)
profiles.purpose: Find places to test instruments that hunt for buried water ice.

profiles.name: Mars astrobiology and sample science
profiles.purpose: Match the rocks and the water history that biosignature searches depend on.

profiles.name: Rover mobility and navigation
profiles.purpose: Match what a rover drives on: slope, roughness and how loose the ground is.

profiles.name: Lava-tube and cave operations
profiles.purpose: Match young basaltic volcanic terrain where collapsed tubes are reachable.

profiles.name: Dust and aeolian processes
profiles.purpose: Match dusty, windy, fine-grained surfaces for dust-mitigation testing.
